prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on what you need. Can you tell me a bit more so I can recommend the right agency?

Quick questions:
- What kind of marketing do you want? (digital/SEO/SEM, social media, branding, creative/ad, PR, content, B2B demand gen, events, performance marketing, etc.)
- What’s your business type and size? (startup, small business, regional company, enterprise)
- Monthly budget range or annual spend?
- Do you need a local Kansas City office/onsite support, or is remote OK?
- Timeline / goals (brand awareness, leads, sales, app installs, fundraising, etc.)
- Any industries or competitors you want the agency to know about?

If you prefer, I can also:
- Give a short list of highly regarded KC agencies by specialty,
- Provide contact info, recent case studies, and estimated pricing,
- Draft an RFP/email you can send to agencies.

Tell me the details you care about and I’ll shortlist the best matches.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
